# Vendored Frontend Skills

These are selective snapshots from the Ossus v0.1 frontend catalog. They are
kept under `skills/vendor` so they remain separate from ONDIGITAL-owned skills.

Imported entries:

- `pbakaus/impeccable`: `impeccable`
- `nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill`: `ui-ux-pro-max`
- `nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill`: `brand`
- `zanwei/design-dna`: `design-dna`
- `emilkowalski/skills`: `review-animations`, `improve-animations`,
  `find-animation-opportunities`, `apple-design`, `prototype`
- `greensock/gsap-skills`: `gsap-core`, `gsap-timeline`,
  `gsap-scrolltrigger`, `gsap-plugins`, `gsap-utils`, `gsap-react`,
  `gsap-performance`, `gsap-frameworks`
- `lottiefiles/motion-design-skill`: `motion-design`

Only the catalog-listed frontend and motion directories were copied. Other
Ossus entries and other skills from these repositories are intentionally
excluded.

Each source directory has a `SOURCE.md` with its commit, license, audit result,
and execution constraints. The local `ui-ux-pro-max` search script was smoke
tested; no installer, hook, networked helper, or file-writing script was run.
Do not run those tools without a separate task and audit.
